deadline_analysis.wcet_us: sum(link_transmission_us on path) + sum(link_propagation_us on path) + sum(node_processing_us for each non-grandmaster node on flow.path) + sum(gate_wait_us per switch egress on path)
deadline_analysis.node_processing_us_source: topology.nodes[].processing_us for every node on flow.path except role grandmaster
deadline_analysis.open_time_ns_for_queue: sum of interval_ns where gate_states[queue] equals gate_open_value
deadline_analysis.switch_egress_ports: for each consecutive triple (prev, upstream, downstream) on flow.path where upstream is a switch, locate schedule where switch_id equals upstream and port resolves from topology link from=upstream,to=downstream field switch_ports[upstream]
deadline_analysis.egress_port_resolution: use link.switch_ports[upstream] when link matches path hop; if absent use first schedule entry port on that switch
deadline_analysis.compliance_deadline_us: flow.deadline_us minus traffic_classes.classes[].deadline_shaving_us for flow.traffic_class; default 0 when absent
deadline_analysis.include_flow_when: flow.enabled is not false and flow.scheduling_exempt is not true
deadline_analysis.inter_frame_gap_us: add (bursts_per_period - 1) * inter_frame_gap_us to wcet_us when bursts_per_period > 1; inter_frame_gap_us defaults to 0

trace_validation.trace_miss_deduplication: when a validated trace qualifies for both observed_miss and clock_skew_miss emit only clock_skew_miss for that trace_id
trace_validation.clock_skew_node_filter: include only topology nodes with role switch on flow.path; always exclude clock_sync.grandmaster
trace_validation.adjusted_latency_us: raw_latency_us + sum(clock_skew_excess_us for each filtered switch on flow.path) + trace.jitter_us
trace_validation.clock_skew_miss_when: adjusted_latency_us > compliance_deadline_us and sum(clock_skew_excess_us on filtered path) > 0
trace_validation.numeric_coercion: cast arrival_us and release_us to float before computing raw_latency_us and before round_latency_us
trace_validation.json_float_fields: latency_us and margin_us in deadline_misses entries must be JSON numbers; whole-valued results still use a fractional form (e.g. 980.0 not 980) in JSON; deadline_us stays a JSON integer and description {deadline_us} renders as an integer string without .0

gate_conflicts.overlap_when: two reserved_windows on same switch_id and port both exclusive true and time ranges overlap with positive overlap_ns
gate_conflicts.overlap_ns: min(end_a, end_b) - max(start_a, start_b) when positive
gate_conflicts.conflict_id_assignment_order: assign GC- sequence after applying sort to the full conflict list
gate_conflicts.conflict_id_assignment_note: Detect overlaps first, sort conflicts per gate_conflicts.sort, then assign conflict_id 001..N in that final order

bandwidth.hyperperiod_us: least_common_multiple of period_us for enabled flows where scheduling_exempt is not true
bandwidth.reserved_mbps: sum over enabled flows traversing link of bandwidth_frame_bytes * 8 * bursts_per_period / period_us
bandwidth.scheduling_exempt_bandwidth: flows with scheduling_exempt true remain in reserved_mbps sums but are excluded from hyperperiod_us LCM and analytical deadline analysis
bandwidth.available_mbps: link.bandwidth_mbps * link.derate_factor where derate_factor defaults to 1.0
bandwidth.available_mbps_format: integer Mbps with no fractional component; truncate toward zero after applying derate_factor

priority_inversion.scope: group traces by egress_node, egress_port, cycle; only traces where validate is not false
priority_inversion.inversion_when: lower-priority trace transmits before higher-priority trace while higher-priority release_us is strictly less than lower-priority transmit_us

schedule_feasibility_score.failing_flows: enabled non-exempt flows with analytical WCET miss
schedule_feasibility_score.eligible_flows: enabled flows where scheduling_exempt is not true

deadline_compliance_rate.validated_traces: traces where validate is not false

miss_id_assignment_note: Controls DL- miss_id sequence during collection only; final misses array order follows outputs.deadline_misses.sort

description_templates.analytical_miss: Analytical WCET {wcet_us} us exceeds deadline {deadline_us} us for {flow_id}
description_templates.observed_miss: Observed latency {latency_us} us exceeds deadline {deadline_us} us for {flow_id} cycle {cycle}
description_templates.clock_skew_miss: Clock-adjusted latency {adjusted_latency_us} us exceeds deadline {deadline_us} us for {flow_id} trace {trace_id}
description_templates.gate_conflict: Exclusive windows {window_a} and {window_b} overlap {overlap_ns} ns on {switch_id} {port}
description_templates.priority_inversion: Queue {lower_queue} transmitted before waiting queue {higher_queue} on {egress_node} {egress_port} cycle {cycle}

placeholder_rules.deadline_us: always int(flow.deadline_us) nominal deadline from message_flows; never compliance_deadline_us; render as integer text without a decimal suffix (900 not 900.0)
placeholder_rules.scope: placeholder_rules apply to description strings in JSON entries and to deadline lines copied into schedule_validation_report.md
placeholder_rules.compliance_vs_nominal: compliance_deadline_us is used only for miss detection and margin_us; description templates and JSON deadline_us field both use nominal flow.deadline_us

report_markdown.title: # TSN Schedule Validation Report — {profile_name}
report_markdown.metrics_value_format: render numeric metrics with exactly metrics.<key>.round_decimals fractional digits; priority_inversion_count is a plain integer

deadline_misses.margin_us: compliance_deadline_us - latency (latency is wcet_us, raw_latency_us, or adjusted_latency_us depending on miss_type); deadline_us field remains nominal flow.deadline_us
deadline_misses.deadline_us: nominal integer flow.deadline_us; same value fills description template placeholder {deadline_us} per description_templates.placeholder_rules
deadline_misses.sort_semantics: Rank miss_type by miss_type_output_order index (not alphabetical), then flow_id ascending, then cycle ascending with null before integers

network_utilization.available_mbps_format: integer string with no decimal point; value is int(link bandwidth_mbps * derate_factor)
network_utilization.hyperperiod_us_format: integer string with no decimal point
